name: QrDataEncoder
src_typeComment: Text -> data-bit-stream encoding (ISO/IEC 18004 section 7.3-7.4). Auto-selects Alphanumeric mode (more compact — 45-character set: 0-9, A-Z, space, $%*+-./:) when the whole string fits it, otherwise falls back to Byte mode (raw UTF-8) for arbitrary text. Only versions 1-9's character-count-indicator bit widths are implemented (9 bits alphanumeric / 8 bits byte) since this generator only supports versions 1-4. Public (not internal) specifically so the Editor-folder self-test — a different default assembly in this no-asmdef project — can call it directly and verify it against a real published reference.

src_members.sig: public static List<bool> EncodeDataBits(string text, int dataCodewordCapacity)
src_members.name: EncodeDataBits
src_members.comment: dataCodewordCapacity is the target version/EC-level's total DATA codeword count (across all blocks combined) — the returned bit list is always padded out to exactly that many codewords. Throws if the text's encoded bit length exceeds that capacity (caller should pick a bigger version and retry).
